strings.zh: 客人{NEWLINE}请往这边！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh, hello!{NEWLINE}Right this way, please!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 初次见面！{SCROLL}我是精灵ＷｉーＦｉ俱乐部的{NEWLINE}引导员青奈,{SCROLL}那么请先往这边！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello.{NEWLINE}I’m glad to meet you.{SCROLL}My name is Teala, and I’m your guide{NEWLINE}to the Pokémon Wi-Fi Club.{SCROLL}Now, please come this way first.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 登录在这个是朋友吧{NEWLINE}里的朋友,{CLEAR}使用ＷｉーＦｉ联络,{SCROLL}就能使用精灵对战{NEWLINE}精灵交换等等的机能了{SCROLL}要听详细介绍吗？
strings.en: That’s your Pal Pad. You may register{NEWLINE}your friends in it.{SCROLL}Once registered, you may link with{NEWLINE}those friends over Nintendo Wi-Fi{CLEAR}Connection to trade Pokémon, battle,{CLEAR}and so on.{SCROLL}Would you like to know more?

strings.zh: 在精灵中心２Ｆ交换精灵,{CLEAR}或在圆形剧场对战的时候,{SCROLL}就能将对手登录在是朋友卡片里。{SCROLL}此外和朋友交换朋友号码的话。{NEWLINE}就可以一起联机了。{SCROLL}要再听一边说明么？
strings.en: You may meet people on the second{NEWLINE}floor of a Pokémon Center for trades{CLEAR}or Colosseum battles.{SCROLL}You may register such people as{NEWLINE}friends in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}You may also manually register friends{NEWLINE}by entering their Friend Codes into{CLEAR}your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}Would you like me to repeat that?

strings.zh: 那么请尽情享受ＷｉーＦｉ联络！
strings.en: I hope you enjoy using Nintendo{NEWLINE}WFC!

strings.zh: 欢迎来到{NEWLINE}精灵中心ＷｉーＦｉ俱乐部！{SCROLL}是有什么疑问吗？
strings.en: Welcome to the Pokémon Center Wi-Fi{NEWLINE}Club!{SCROLL}May I help you with anything?

strings.zh: 那么说明一下ＷｉーＦｉ俱乐部{NEWLINE}的游戏方法！{SCROLL}中央的柜台可以连接到{CLEAR}ＷｉーＦｉ联络！{SCROLL}登录在朋友卡片里的朋友,{CLEAR}使用ＷｉーＦｉ联络,{SCROLL}就能使用精灵对战{SCROLL}精灵交换等等的机能了。
strings.en: Let me explain how the Pokémon Wi-Fi{NEWLINE}Club is set up.{SCROLL}From the middle counter, you may use{NEWLINE}Nintendo Wi-Fi Connection.{SCROLL}Over Nintendo WFC, you may conduct{NEWLINE}trades and battles with friends{CLEAR}that you’ve registered in{CLEAR}your Pal Pad.

strings.en: ...Oh?{SCROLL}I’m sorry, but you don’t have any{NEWLINE}friends registered in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}The Wi-Fi Club cannot be used if{NEWLINE}no friends are in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}Would you like to get your{NEWLINE}Friend Code? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: ⋯⋯啊嘞？{SCROLL}⋯⋯啊啦？{SCROLL}客人您还没有在朋友手册{NEWLINE}里登录朋友呢{SCROLL}在ＷｉーＦｉ俱乐部,{NEWLINE}没有在朋友手册{CLEAR}登录朋友的话,{CLEAR}是无法使用的。{SCROLL}请登录了朋友之后再来。
strings.en: ...Huh?{SCROLL}...Oh?{SCROLL}I’m sorry, but you don’t have any{NEWLINE}friends registered in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}The Wi-Fi Club cannot be used if{NEWLINE}no friends are in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}Please register friends in your{NEWLINE}Pal Pad, and then come back.

strings.zh: ＷｉーＦｉ俱乐部里,{NEWLINE}能够与朋友手册中的{CLEAR}朋友享受精灵交换和{CLEAR}通信对战的乐趣。{SCROLL}这里的通信对战{NEWLINE}分成单人和双人２种,{SCROLL}并分成「无限制」「等级５０」{NEWLINE}「等级１００」三种,{SCROLL}「等级５０」和「等级１００」的{CLEAR}精灵全部得是那个等级的。{SCROLL}要连接{NEWLINE}ＷｉーＦｉ吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: At the Wi-Fi Club, you may enjoy{NEWLINE}trades and link battles with friends{CLEAR}registered in your Pal Pad.{SCROLL}Link battles here come in two kinds:{NEWLINE}Single and Double.{SCROLL}They are also split into three kinds:{NEWLINE}Free, Level 50 and Level 100.{SCROLL}In Level 50 and Level 100, all{NEWLINE}Pokémon have to be at that level.{SCROLL}Connect to Nintendo WFC? {VAR:0200:0}
